metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over 3 exercises that will help offer long-lasting low back pain relief without the need for aggravating twisting or bending movements. 

These exercises will focus on targeting muscle tightness and weakness, a main cause of lower back pain, all while keeping the back straight (in a safe position).

Each exercise works a little differently, they're going to target different muscles. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

Watch now and safely get lower back pain relief!
